newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices rise in some areas.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices rise in some areas.

text.p: Millfeed prices rose at a few locations in reaction to feed mixers covering some immediate needs, dealers said.
After more than a week of light sales, dealers said feedmixers needed material for immediate production demands. Deferred values were mostly unchanged.
Kansas City rail millfeed was bid at $91 per ton and offered at $93, both up $6 from Wednesday. In Texas, some promptly shipped millfeeds traded at $105, up $10 from trades Wednesday.
Southeast market values were unchanged to slightly lower. Carolina millfeed values were bid unchanged at $90 and offered down $2 at $98.
Lower CBOT corn futures this week discouraged buyers from securing large amounts of millfeeds on ideas prices for all feed ingredients were trending lower.
